method.metric: Individual animation on/off with all other detected motion frozen
method.control: Explorer embedded-input enableAnimations; CSS and Draw motion verified on/off
method.cpuScope: All renderer threads in a dedicated Chrome instance; excludes GPU process
method.responsiveness: Synthetic click dispatch to handler and next rAF; not real editor typing or physical display latency
method.frameScope: Parent requestAnimationFrame intervals; scheduling proxy, not compositor/presentation frames

cpuThresholds.low: all paired deltas between -1 and 1 pp

limitations: Exploratory 3-pair screening, not statistical proof or product validation.
Same synthetic click probe in both conditions; shared-machine contention is not controlled.
Only sustained CSS/Draw motion is supported. One-shot, changing-content and other JS states require dedicated action replay.
One animation instance per comparison; CSS/Web Animation timeline advancement and SVG mutations verify isolation. Uncontrolled updates invalidate attribution.
